name: deed.page
summary: Publishes a file or folder to a permanent public deed.page URL in one call, with no account, API key, email code or claim link.
description: The repository is a plugin that bundles the deed.page agent skill with the hosted deed.page MCP server. The skill is one file, skills/deed-page/SKILL.md, and does the publish with one curl request. The MCP server runs at https://deed.page/mcp over Streamable HTTP. The README gives the Claude Code install as CLI commands, claude plugin marketplace add f-o-x11/deed-page-skill and then claude plugin install deed-page@deed-page; the install commands on this page are the same two steps typed as /plugin commands inside Claude Code.

Ask the agent to publish a folder to deed.page or to host a report and give you a link. It calls publish_site with the files and answers with the live URL; to change the site later it calls update_site with the same slug and token. The first publish returns an owner token once, and that token is the key to update or delete the sites it owns.

Free plan: 25 sites, 25 MB per site, 60 publishes per hour, and free sites show a small "Published with deed.page" badge. Paid plans raise the limits and never show the badge: Hobby ($3/mo) and Pro ($15/mo). When a plan limit is hit, the skill tells the agent to show you the price and a Stripe Checkout upgrade link; the agent may complete the payment itself only if you explicitly approved the purchase and it has a payment tool you approved. Free sites are public, so do not publish secrets. Static files only. It is a community project, not made or endorsed by Anthropic.
notice: The plugin uploads the files you publish to deed.page, a hosted service run by Avatar 8 LLC. The first publish returns an owner token, which the skill saves to ~/.config/deed-page/token and sends to deed.page on every publish. SKILL.md tells the agent to use it for requests such as "give me a link", and also when it runs unattended and cannot ask a human for a code or a click, so files can go to a public URL without anyone confirming. Sites published on the free plan are public. The plugin installs from its own repository's marketplace, not from Anthropic's.
